title: Pure Darklord
summary: The page's Glorious Gallery Darklord build: Darklord cards with the two Forbidden Quick-Plays that Gulgolet and Djehuty fetch, plus generic staples. The Solfachord hybrid is left out. Djehuty summons another Darklord from the Deck, Gulgolet makes two Level 6 Tokens for Darklord Eveningstar, and the big Darklords pay 1000 LP to copy a Darklord Spell/Trap from the GY and shuffle it back. Fallen Angel in Darkness summons any Darklord from the hand, Deck or banishment, ignoring its conditions, and copying it from the GY makes the loop. Djehuty and Gulgolet lock you into Fairies for the turn.

allow.Forbidden Crown: 2026 Quick-Play the page's build runs: Djehuty returns and Gulgolet searches Forbidden Quick-Plays.
